detail.en: The ENSO Diagnostic Discussion of 13 April 2023 changed the status to "El Niño Watch": ENSO-neutral expected through spring, followed by a 62% chance of El Niño developing during May-July 2023. The previous discussion (9 March 2023) had been the "Final La Niña Advisory".

detail.en: In the ZARC risk table 2022/2023 (MAPA Portaria 385 of 8 December 2022), rainfed wheat at Cruz Alta has its lowest risk class (20%) from 1 June to 20 July for cycle group 22 (ten-day periods 16 to 20), from 11 June for group 21 and from 21 June for group 20, all ending on 20 July; the 30% class opens on 21 May. The same window holds for the three soil types of that table.

detail.en: Operating (custeio) credit for wheat registered in the Central Bank SICOR system, summed by calendar year of issue over 18 municipalities of the Planalto Médio: the 2023 value was 3.1% below 2022 in constant reais (December 2025, IPCA), and the financed area of January-October was 2.3% above January-October 2022 (155,964 against 152,465 ha). The annual financed area was 0.5% lower.

detail.en: 2023 wheat yield (IBGE PAM) below 75% of each municipality's 1981-2025 linear trend in 14 of 18 municipalities (11 at 70%, 16 at 80%). Cruz Alta: 1,500 kg/ha against a trend of 2,736 kg/ha.

title.en: Wheat failed in 14 of 18 Planalto Médio municipalities

detail.en: Wheat: IBGE PAM revenue per planted hectare (1,500 kg/ha at the implicit 2023 price) minus the CONAB production cost for Cruz Alta (March 2023 sheet), in December 2025 reais. Against the operating cost the margin was -3,829 R$/ha; against the variable cost only, -3,268 R$/ha. Cover crop (black oat, no harvest, no revenue): 332 R$/ha of seed and sowing, from the only official cost found (Embrapa Trigo, 2007 prices updated by IPCA). Fallow has no sourced cost and is not given a value.
